name: visual_sums_poppler
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','2','-l','2','-scale-to','1300','-png','-singlefile',str(p/'sources/complete-sums.pdf')],capture_output=True,check=True);print(base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode())
